name: openHASP
author: openHASP contributors (HASwitchPlate)
description: openHASP touch panel for Home Assistant: JSONL pages driven over MQTT. The HA openHASP integration finds it (node "plate") and pushes your pages; or copy pages.jsonl to /sdcard/apps/openhasp/data. MQTT from Settings > Home.

descriptions.en: openHASP touch panel for Home Assistant: JSONL pages driven over MQTT. The HA openHASP integration finds it (node "plate") and pushes your pages; or copy pages.jsonl to /sdcard/apps/openhasp/data. MQTT from Settings > Home.
descriptions.it: Pannello touch openHASP per Home Assistant: pagine JSONL comandate via MQTT. L'integrazione openHASP di HA lo trova (nodo "plate") e carica le pagine; o copia pages.jsonl in /sdcard/apps/openhasp/data. MQTT da Impostazioni > Casa.
